cites.quote: The dashboard has a tile `Awaiting outcome`.
Scheduled appointments that have not `started yet` are never counted.
The count does not change with the `period selector`.
When there are no such appointments the tile `shows 0`.
The `other tiles` of the dashboard are unchanged.
No `contact details` appear on the tile or the dashboard.
Today, Last 7 days or Last 30 days
selecting it opens the list behind the count
never in lists, the dashboard or logs
The rest of the dashboard is unchanged and shows no private data

questions.text: May contact details (phone, email) appear in the appointment list that the Awaiting outcome tile opens, or should the no-contact-details rule (REQ-11) also cover that list? The artifact records this as its own non-blocking Q-01.

rubric_items.reason: Stories S-1 to S-4 trace all 11 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-11). The intent has no assumed REQs.
S-1 to S-3 each have one outcome. S-4 still combines two: the dashboard is unchanged (REQ-8, REQ-9) and it shows no private data (REQ-10, REQ-11).

Each AC is Given/When/Then. S-1 AC3 now places a start at exactly now, so a <= count fails it. Most-recent status, date-based counting and a period applied to the count or list are each caught. Both unchanged partitions are covered.
All values are test-fixture times and dates. The out-of-window date is explained inline using the glossary Period (C12). No invented limits.
Clear, consistent terms. The body and front-matter copies of every AC now match, and Q-01 is stated consistently in the front matter and the body.
